TITLE: SELF-SEALING SEED CAPSULE WITH MOISTURE GATE

FIELD
The present disclosure relates to containers for germinating seeds outdoors, and more particularly to a capsule that admits water only after the surrounding soil reaches a threshold moisture level.

SUMMARY
In one embodiment, a seed capsule includes a shell formed of a biodegradable polymer and a moisture gate disposed in an aperture of the shell. As used herein, the term "moisture gate" means a plug that remains substantially impermeable to liquid water until it absorbs water equal to at least 30 percent of its dry mass, after which it swells and becomes permeable.

The shell may be spherical, ovoid, or faceted. As used herein, "biodegradable" refers to a material that loses at least half of its mass within 180 days when buried in moist soil at 20 degrees Celsius.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION
The capsule 10 comprises a shell 12 and a moisture gate 14. The shell 12 encloses a cavity 16 holding at least one seed 18 and an optional nutrient pellet 20. In preferred embodiments the moisture gate 14 is a compressed cellulose plug, although gelatin and alginate plugs are also contemplated.

A tether 22 may join two or more capsules in a line so that they can be planted in a row. The tether 22 is preferably made of the same biodegradable polymer as the shell 12.

In some embodiments, a vent 24 on the side of the shell opposite the moisture gate allows trapped air to escape as water enters the cavity. The vent 24 is smaller in diameter than the moisture gate 14.

CLAIMS
1. A seed capsule comprising:
a shell formed of a biodegradable polymer and enclosing a cavity;
at least one seed disposed within the cavity; and
a moisture gate disposed in an aperture of the shell, the moisture gate configured to become permeable after absorbing water.

2. The seed capsule of claim 1, wherein the moisture gate comprises a compressed cellulose plug.

3. The seed capsule of claim 1, further comprising a nutrient pellet disposed within the cavity.

4. The seed capsule of claim 2, further comprising a vent on a side of the shell opposite the moisture gate, the vent having a smaller diameter than the moisture gate.

5. A planting strip comprising a plurality of seed capsules according to claim 1 joined by a tether.
